diffs.before: The publish gate for SEO basics: blocks publishing when titles, meta descriptions, headings, alt text, or links are broken.
diffs.after: Checks before publishing or scheduling: titles, descriptions, headings, alt text, links, HTML blocks and HTTPS embeds.

before.description:
Publish Check is the publish gate for SEO basics. When an editor clicks Publish, it checks the draft and rejects publication with a short reason when the title is too long, the meta description is missing or off-length, the body contains an H1, an image has no alt text, or internal links are missing. Block mode or warn mode, reports in the admin.

It asks for one permission: hooks.content-policy:register. No network, no content read or write.

Built and maintained by [EmDash plugins](https://emdashplugins.nl). Source: [github.com/smrht/emdash-plugins](https://github.com/smrht/emdash-plugins).

after.description:
Publish Check is the publish gate for SEO basics. When an editor clicks Publish, it checks the draft and rejects publication with a short reason when the title is too long, the meta description is missing or off-length, the body contains an H1, an image has no alt text, or internal links are missing. Checks both Publish and Schedule. Version 0.3.0 also inspects static HTML blocks and EmDash 1.1 iframe blocks. Isolated blocks do not count as host-page headings or internal links. HTTPS embed URLs are required; missing titles are warnings. No JavaScript execution or remote URL requests. This is not a security or ranking guarantee. Block mode or warn mode, reports in the admin.

It asks for one permission: hooks.content-policy:register. No network, no content read or write.

Built and maintained by [EmDash plugins](https://emdashplugins.nl). Source: [github.com/smrht/emdash-plugins](https://github.com/smrht/emdash-plugins).
